benchmark.scope: Fresh-process create-case/import-filesystem/persist workflow with warm OS file caches. No GUI and no ingest modules.

method.primary: Popen start through application process exit, including bootstrap and persistence; owned Solr cleanup is afterwards
method.native: Release application core, selected-file SHA-256 + before/after source checks + logical SHA-256 + helper enumeration + JSON cache
method.autopsy: Full NetBeans CLI, fresh user/cache/case and private Solr, image import into SQLite, adapted macOS ARM64 runtime
method.sampling: 5 ms libproc exact owned process group, observes Native CLI/helper or Autopsy JVM/Solr. RSS sampled and CPU lower bound; unavailable per-process readings are retained as coverage gaps, not zero consumption.
method.validation: Exact known payloads/stream classification and exports plus independent UTC timestamp oracle gates outside timing. Native fractions checked; Autopsy compared at whole-second precision. No full fractional metadata parity claim.
method.cache: Hashes before each run warm OS caches; Autopsy NetBeans user/module cache is fresh each run; no disk cache flush
method.baselineLimitation: Mac-compatible baseline, with recorded effective patches/adapters; not a pristine vendor-stock platform build.
method.attempts: One excluded correctness warmup and a fixed measured schedule per image; no automatic replacements or omission of failed attempts.

safetyAdapter.purpose: Prevent upstream fallback process queries from matching unrelated Solr instances

autopsy.repairScope: Copied POSIX timezone environment; named NTFS directory DATA stream import and regular-file classification

resources.observedProcessCoverage: Unproven: short-lived descendants, between-sample peaks and exit tails may be missed even without reported errors
resources.limitations: Includes successfully sampled owned main JVM, Solr and shell children; Python and GUI excluded. Last-live CPU/disk samples omit exit tails and unseen short processes; they are lower bounds, not wait4 kernel totals.

records.processWaitMethod: blocking Popen.wait() worker with immediate time.monotonic() observation

resources.method: libproc PROC_PGRP_ONLY/rusage_info_v2; exact new-session group and PID creation identities
resources.observedProcessCoverage: Unproven: short-lived descendants, between-sample peaks and exit tails may be missed even without reported errors
resources.limitations: Includes successfully sampled owned main JVM, Solr and shell children; Python and GUI excluded. Denied/unavailable PIDs are retained as bounded failure receipts and excluded from sums, making coverage partial. Sequential RSS samples can miss peaks. Last-live CPU/disk samples omit exit tails and unseen short processes; they are lower bounds, not wait4 kernel totals.
